name: Detroit Furniture Inc
old_description: Furnish your living room in one easy step with coordinated living room sets from Detroit Furniture in Dearborn, MI. Our sets include matching sofas, loveseats, and accent pieces designed to work together, so your room looks pulled together from day one without the hassle of mixing and matching individual pieces. Buying a living room set is also one of the most cost-effective ways to furnish a room — you get a complete, coordinated look for less than purchasing each piece separately. Our sets come in a range of styles from casual and contemporary to traditional and transitional, with fabric, leather, and performance material options. Whether you're moving into a new home, updating your current space, or furnishing a rental property, a living room set makes the process simple. Visit our furniture showroom in Dearborn to see complete living room sets displayed in room-style settings. Shop in store or online with delivery and financing available.
about:
Detroit Furniture Inc operates a furniture showroom and online store from its location on Miller Road in Dearborn, Michigan. The business was established in 2006, founded by an industry veteran with more than 25 years of experience in the home furnishings trade.

The company stocks a range of residential furniture including coordinated living room sets, sofas, loveseats, recliners, bedroom sets, mattresses, dining room pieces, entertainment units, and youth bedroom collections. Inventory features brands such as Ashley Furniture, with items displayed in room-style settings at the showroom. Services include white-glove delivery with in-home setup, assembly, and financing options for qualified buyers.

Customers are primarily homeowners, renters, and property managers furnishing primary residences, vacation homes, or rental units. The retailer serves the metropolitan Detroit area through its physical showroom and ships nationally via its e-commerce platform.

The founder's stated goal was to simplify the furnishing process by offering curated, coordinated sets that eliminate the need to mix and match individual pieces, delivering a complete look at a lower combined cost.
